# Planora 1.7.10
## 中文 - 修复 1.7.9 中课程出勤仍显示“未记录”：ManageBac 返回的课表颜色可能使用 `color(srgb …)` 或 `color(display-p3 …)`，现已按其正确的数值范围解析。 - 在真实课表页面只读核对了颜色类别；新增回归测试覆盖绿色、橙色、红色、灰色，以及重新同步后纠正旧的“未记录”课程。 - 更新后请重新同步 ManageBac，旧课程状态会随同步更新。不会修改学校端记录。 - 39 项 ManageBac 测试通过。真实账户在新版 App 中的完整同步结果仍需核对。
## English - Fixed lessons still showing "Not Recorded" in 1.7.9. ManageBac may return timetable colors as `color(srgb …)` or `color(display-p3 …)`; Planora now interprets their numeric ranges correctly. - Checked color categories against the live timetable without changing school data. Regression tests cover green, orange, red, and gray lessons, plus correcting previously imported records on resync. - Sync ManageBac again after updating to refresh existing lessons. No school records are changed. - All 39 ManageBac tests passed. End-to-end sync in the updated app still needs live-account verification.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.9
## 中文 - 修复 ManageBac 时间表右侧 Details 默认收起时，出勤汇总无法导入、首页出勤率空白的问题。同步时会展开并读取课堂出勤汇总。 - 将 `TBD` 与 `Not Recorded` 识别为尚未记录；改进浅色课堂背景及边框的出勤状态识别，不把作业提示色当成出勤状态。 - 更新后请重新同步 ManageBac。不会修改学校端的出勤数据。 - 38 项 ManageBac 回归测试通过，iOS 模拟器目标构建通过。真实账户在新版 App 中的完整同步结果仍需核对。 - Mac 保留 Sparkle 签名更新及带内置背景的 DMG；iPhone 和 iPad 不使用 Sparkle。
## English - Fixed a blank Home attendance rate when ManageBac's timetable Details panel was collapsed. Sync now expands the panel and reads the classroom attendance overview. - Treats `TBD` and `Not Recorded` as unrecorded, and improves detection of pale lesson backgrounds and borders without interpreting assignment badges as attendance. - Sync ManageBac again after updating. Planora does not change school attendance data. - All 38 ManageBac regression tests and the iOS Simulator build passed. End-to-end sync in the updated app still needs checking with a live account. - The Mac release retains signed Sparkle updates and a DMG with an embedded background. Sparkle is not included on iPhone or iPad.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.8
## 中文 - 成绩新增系统分段控件：Mac 和 iPad 首页可切换数字与按时间排列的横向柱状图，课程成绩可切换数字、柱状图与折线图；不同学科以不同颜色区分。iPhone 首页不增加此切换。 - 出勤同步新增独立项目，优先读取 ManageBac 时间表右侧的课堂出勤汇总，逐节课状态作为补充；首页与课程页均可查看出勤。更新后请重新同步一次。 - 修正首页出勤率与单周日期混用的问题。任务详情的分数显示不变。 - Mac 与 iOS 构建及成绩、出勤解析测试通过。真实学校页面的出勤汇总仍需使用者验证。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle、签名更新源和带隐藏背景文件夹的 DMG。
## English - Added a system segmented control for grades. On Mac and iPad, Home switches between numbers and a chronological, horizontally scrolling bar chart; Course grades offer numbers, bars, and lines. Subjects use distinct colors. The iPhone Home screen has no new switch. - Attendance is now a separate sync item. Planora prefers the classroom attendance overview in ManageBac timetable Details, with per-lesson states as a fallback. Attendance is accessible from Home and Courses. Sync again after updating. - Removed a misleading single-week date beside the overall Home attendance rate. Task detail grades are unchanged. - Mac and iOS builds and focused grade/attendance parsing tests passed. Live school-page attendance still needs user validation. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and a DMG with an embedded hidden background folder.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.7
## 中文 - 新增课堂出勤：Mac 侧栏位于课程与消息之间，首页位于学习进度下方；iPhone、iPad 可从首页进入。 - 同步 ManageBac 当前课表周的出勤状态，按已同步的周查看课程明细。区分出席、迟到、缺席和未记录，不将班主任点名统计混入课堂出勤。 - 出勤率为（出席＋迟到）除以已记录课次，未记录不计入分母。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac。 - 已通过 Mac、iOS 构建和课表读取、重复同步测试；真实学校页面的出勤读取结果尚待用户验证，不代表已导入全学期历史。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle 和签名更新源；DMG 内置隐藏背景文件夹和 Finder 背景配置。
## English - Added classroom attendance between Courses and Messages in the Mac sidebar, and below Learning Progress on the Home screen. Available from Home on iPhone and iPad too. - Reads attendance from the current ManageBac timetable week and displays previously synced weeks. Present, late, absent and unrecorded lessons remain distinct; homeroom totals are not mixed with classroom attendance. - Attendance rate is (present + late) / recorded lessons. Unrecorded lessons are excluded. Sync ManageBac once after updating. - Mac and iOS builds and focused timetable/import tests passed. Live school-page extraction still needs user validation; full-term history is not automatically imported. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and an embedded hidden DMG background with Finder metadata.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.6
## 中文
- 修正 Mac 侧栏图标的布局方式，针对首次启动及台前调度切回应用时图标消失的问题，改为独立、固定尺寸的图标行。 - 修复 ManageBac 截止时间被日期整理代码重置为凌晨 12:00 的问题，保留导入的时分和时区对应的时间点。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac，恢复此前已被重置的截止时间。 - 提醒、重复和批量操作改用 Mac 原生分组表单，内容从顶部排列，修正大片空白和控件挤在中央的问题。 - DMG 继续使用 Finder 原生背景设置，图片保存在映像内部的 `.background/installation.png`，并保留中英文安装说明。 - 保留 Mac 专用的 Vendor/Sparkle 更新框架，提供签名更新归档和 appcast。iPhone/iPad 不包含 Sparkle。
验证范围：Mac 通用版本及 iOS Simulator 构建、截止时间针对性回归测试、DMG 内容和更新签名检查。台前调度和新设备的最终显示效果由用户验证，本次不进行长时间真机测试。
Mac 应用使用临时签名，未经过 Apple Developer ID 签名或公证；Sparkle 更新签名用于验证更新来源。
## English
- Replaced automatic sidebar label icons with independently laid-out, fixed-size symbols to address missing icons at first launch and when returning through Stage Manager. - Fixed date normalization resetting ManageBac deadlines to midnight. Imported times now retain their exact timestamp across time zones. Sync ManageBac once after updating to restore previously reset deadlines. - Switched reminder, recurrence, and bulk-action editors to native Mac grouped forms with top-aligned content. - Retained Finder-native DMG background settings and the embedded `.background/installation.png`, with bilingual installation instructions. - Retained the Mac-only vendored Sparkle framework, signed update archive, and appcast. Sparkle is not included in iPhone/iPad builds.
Validation covers the universal Mac and iOS Simulator builds, focused deadline regression tests, DMG contents, and update signatures. Final Stage Manager and new-device appearance checks are left to the user; no extended physical-device testing was performed.
The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization. Sparkle signatures verify the update source.

# Planora 1.7.5
Planora 1.7.5 修复 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上的多项任务交互与布局问题，并改进 Mac 安装包的可移植性。
## 中文
### iPhone / iPad
- 修复在首页周历中点击日期、切换周历/月历或重新布局时可能出现界面卡住并最终闪退的问题。 - 修复 iPad 上周历/月历切换过程中系统 `List` 单元格高度在不同值之间反复变化并触发 UIKit 布局循环的问题。 - 调整周历与月历的嵌套布局，避免日历内容参与不稳定的尺寸反馈。 - 改进不同 iPhone 与 iPad 宽度下的日历自适应布局，同时保留现有 iOS / iPadOS 导航与系统界面逻辑。
### 任务交互
- 修复任务左滑操作时只有文字和内容移动、白色任务卡片背景留在原位的问题。 - 任务卡片背景现在与任务内容一起参与滑动，使左滑操作保持完整一致。
### Mac
- 修复首次打开任务详情时明显卡顿、详情内容延迟出现的问题。 - 减少打开任务详情过程中不必要的全任务查询和保存操作，使详情视图更快显示。 - 改进任务详情区域的窗口缩放逻辑，降低不必要的最小宽度限制，使任务详情在较窄窗口下仍能正常使用。 - 修复正常缩小 Mac 窗口时任务详情内容可能被挤出可用区域的问题。 - 改进任务工作区筛选控件的响应式布局，使其能够根据可用宽度调整排列。 - 保留现有 SwiftData 数据、任务关系、重复任务删除范围、Mac 原生工作区以及数据迁移逻辑。
### DMG
- 修复 DMG 安装背景依赖开发 Mac 本地路径的问题。 - 安装背景现在真正存储在 DMG 内部隐藏的 `.background` 目录中。 - Finder 的背景配置引用磁盘映像内部资源，不再依赖开发机器上的绝对文件路径。 - DMG 继续包含 Planora、Applications 快捷方式和 `INSTALLATION.txt`。 - 发布包继续提供 Sparkle 更新 ZIP、DMG 和 SHA-256 校验值。
### 验证
- iPhone 回归测试通过，包括周历反复切换、日期变化和窄屏布局。 - 在 iPad 上复现并修复周历/月历切换导致的 UIKit 布局循环问题。 - Mac Release 构建通过，并检查任务详情在多种窗口宽度下的布局与加载行为。 - 最终 DMG 已重新挂载检查，确认隐藏背景资源、Finder 配置、Applications 快捷方式、安装说明、App 签名和磁盘映像完整性。 - Planora 1.7.5 保持版本号 `1.7.5`、build `20`。
### 更新系统
- Mac 软件更新继续使用 Sparkle 2.9.6。 - Sparkle 仍仅包含在 macOS 版本中。 - 更新 ZIP 继续使用 Ed25519 签名验证。 - Sparkle 私钥仍只保存在发布环境的 Keychain 中，不提交到 Git。 - 本版本仍未使用 Apple Developer ID 公证；Sparkle 签名与 Apple Developer ID / notarization 相互独立。
---
## English
Planora 1.7.5 fixes several task interaction and layout issues across iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and improves the portability of the Mac installer.
### iPhone / iPad
- Fixed an issue where interacting with dates in the Home calendar, switching between week and month views, or relaying out the calendar could cause the interface to become unresponsive and eventually crash. - Fixed an iPad issue where the system `List` cell height could repeatedly oscillate between different values during week/month transitions and eventually trigger a UIKit layout-loop assertion. - Adjusted the nested week and month calendar layouts to avoid unstable size-feedback behavior. - Improved calendar adaptation across different iPhone and iPad widths while preserving the existing iOS / iPadOS navigation and system interface behavior.
### Task Interaction
- Fixed task swipe actions where the text and content moved while the white task-card background remained stationary. - The complete task card now moves consistently with the swipe interaction.
### Mac
- Fixed noticeable delays and temporary loading stalls when opening a task detail view for the first time. - Reduced unnecessary full-task queries and save operations while opening task details so the detail view can appear more quickly. - Improved task-detail window resizing by reducing unnecessary minimum-width constraints, allowing the workspace to remain usable at narrower window sizes. - Fixed task-detail content being pushed outside the usable area during normal Mac window resizing. - Improved the responsive layout of task-workspace filter controls so they can adapt to the available width. - Preserved existing SwiftData content, task relationships, recurring-task deletion scopes, the native Mac workspace, and existing migration behavior.
### DMG
- Fixed the DMG installation background depending on a local path on the development Mac. - The installation background is now physically stored inside the disk image under the hidden `.background` directory. - Finder now references the background resource inside the mounted disk image instead of an absolute path on the development machine. - The DMG continues to contain Planora, an Applications shortcut, and `INSTALLATION.txt`. - The release continues to provide the Sparkle update ZIP, DMG, and SHA-256 checksums.
### Validation
- Passed iPhone regression coverage including repeated week-calendar switching, date changes, and narrow-width layouts. - Reproduced and fixed the UIKit layout loop triggered by week/month calendar transitions on iPad. - Passed the Mac Release build and checked task-detail loading and layout behavior at multiple window widths. - Remounted and verified the final DMG, including its hidden background resource, Finder configuration, Applications shortcut, installation guide, application signature, and disk-image integrity. - Planora remains version `1.7.5`, build `20`.
### Update System
- Mac software updates continue to use Sparkle 2.9.6. - Sparkle remains macOS-only. - Update archives continue to use Ed25519 signature verification. - The Sparkle private key remains in the release environment's Keychain and is not committed to Git. - This release is still not Apple Developer ID notarized; Sparkle signing remains independent from Apple Developer ID signing and notarization.
